spans.s: भुशुंडि(डी) f. A kind of weapon.
भुशुंडि(डी) f. A kind of weapon.
भूतृण m. a kind of fragrant grass.
भू-पुत्री, -सुता f. an epithet of Sītā, daughter of Janaka.
भू-शक्र m. a king, a sovereign.
भू-शय m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
भू-स्पृश् m. 1. a man; 2. mankind; 3. a Vaiśya.
भू-स्वर्ग m. an epithet of the mountain Meru.

भूष् vt. 1P, 10U (pp. भूषित; pres. भूषति, भूषयति-ते) 1. To adorn, to decorate, भूषयांगं प्रमाणं चेद्रामो गंतुं यत स्व च Bt.xx.15; 2. (Atm.) to adorn oneself, e.g. भूषयते कन्या स्वयमेव; 3. to spread with.With वि-, to adorn, to decorate, केयूरा न विभूषयंति पुरुषम् Bhartr.ii.19, Rt.iii.20, Sis.ix.33.
भूषण (I) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
भूषण (II) n. 1. the act of decorating; 2. an ornament, an article of embellishment, शररिसादादसमग्रभूषणा R.iii.2, xiii.57, Vikr.Ch.i.25.
भूषा f. 1. Adorning, decorating; 2. an ornament, जगति विदुषां कंठभूषात्वमेतु Vikr.Ch.xviii.102; 3. a jewel.
भूषित a. (f. ता) Adorned, emblished, ornamented.
भूषित a. (f. ता) Adorned, emblished, ornamented.
भूष्णु a. 1. Being, becoming, विनाप्यस्मदलंभूष्णुरिज्यायै तपसः सुतः Sis.ii.9; 2. wising for happiness or prosperity, M.iv.135.
